statement:
∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (γ : ℝ → ℂ) (a b M : ℝ),
  a ≤ b →
    (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, ‖f (γ t)‖ ≤ M) →
      IntervalIntegrable (fun t => ‖deriv γ t‖) volume a b → ‖cint f γ a b‖ ≤ M * length γ a b

universal.type: ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, ‖f (γ t)‖ ≤ M
universal.name: hM

universal.type: IntervalIntegrable (fun t => ‖deriv γ t‖) volume a b
universal.name: hγ
